name: FishPerch
concept: A perch for the fish counter: its own model for the medium catch; the small and large catch scale the same Meshy generation.
prompt: A single European river perch fish, whole, swimming pose seen from the side, deep arched body, two separate dorsal fins the first one spiny and tall, spread tail fin, green-olive back with six dark vertical bars across the flanks, yellowish belly, bright orange-red pelvic and anal fins. Realistic game prop, no base, no stand, no water, no text, no logos.
texture_prompt: European perch: olive green back, dark vertical bars on yellow-green flanks, bright orange-red lower fins.
